X Series (Caged Roller Clutch)

These are large inch-size roller clutches from the Torrington line. Unlike the FC/HF series, they have no drawn-cup outer ring; only a cage (rollers + sprags) is supplied, with the housing and shaft directly acting as the outer and inner rings.
